# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # A small label. Renders a <span>, or an <a> when given href:, which turns on
  # the variants' hover styles and the focus ring, like shadcn's
  # <Badge render={<a />}>. An icon marked data-icon="inline-start" or
  # "inline-end" gets tighter padding on its side.
  class Badge < Base
    BASE = [
      "group/badge inline-flex h-5 w-fit shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1 overflow-hidden whitespace-nowrap",
      "rounded-4xl border border-transparent px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium transition-all",
      "has-data-[icon=inline-end]:pr-1.5 has-data-[icon=inline-start]:pl-1.5",
      "[&>svg]:pointer-events-none [&>svg]:size-3!",
      "focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-[3px] focus-visible:ring-ring/50",
      "aria-invalid:border-destructive aria-invalid:ring-destructive/20 dark:aria-invalid:ring-destructive/40"
    ].freeze

    # :md is shadcn's only size; :sm and :lg are RubyUI extras.
    SIZES = {
      sm: "h-4 px-1.5",
      md: "",
      lg: "h-6 px-2.5 text-sm"
    }.freeze

    # Variants mirror shadcn; pass class: for any other color.
    VARIANTS = {
      default: "bg-primary text-primary-foreground [a]:hover:bg-primary/80",
      secondary: "bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground [a]:hover:bg-secondary/80",
      destructive: "bg-destructive/10 text-destructive dark:bg-destructive/20 [a]:hover:bg-destructive/20 " \
        "focus-visible:ring-destructive/20 dark:focus-visible:ring-destructive/40",
      outline: "border-border text-foreground [a]:hover:bg-muted [a]:hover:text-muted-foreground",
      ghost: "hover:bg-muted hover:text-muted-foreground dark:hover:bg-muted/50",
      link: "text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline"
    }.freeze

    # Older name of :default, kept so variant: :primary keeps working.
    ALIASES = {primary: :default}.freeze

    def initialize(variant: :default, size: :md, href: nil, **attrs)
      @variant = variant.to_s.to_sym
      @variant = ALIASES.fetch(@variant, @variant)
      @variant = :default unless VARIANTS.key?(@variant) # nil or unknown: default look
      @size = SIZES.key?(size.to_s.to_sym) ? size.to_s.to_sym : :md
      @href = href
      super(**attrs)
    end

    def view_template(&)
      if @href
        a(href: @href, **attrs, &)
      else
        span(**attrs, &)
      end
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "badge", variant: @variant},
        class: [BASE, SIZES.fetch(@size), VARIANTS.fetch(@variant)]
      }
    end
  end
end

docs_markdown:
# Badge

Displays a badge or a component that looks like a badge.

## Usage

### Default

```ruby
Badge { "Badge" }
```

### Secondary

```ruby
Badge(variant: :secondary) { "Secondary" }
```

### Destructive

```ruby
Badge(variant: :destructive) { "Destructive" }
```

### Outline

```ruby
Badge(variant: :outline) { "Outline" }
```

### Ghost

```ruby
Badge(variant: :ghost) { "Ghost" }
```

### Link

```ruby
Badge(variant: :link, href: "#") { "Link" }
```

### With Icon

```ruby
div(class: "flex flex-wrap gap-2 justify-center") do
  Badge(variant: :secondary) do
    svg(xmlns: "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", width: "24", height: "24", viewbox: "0 0 24 24", fill: "none",
      stroke: "currentColor", stroke_width: "2", stroke_linecap: "round", stroke_linejoin: "round",
      aria_hidden: "true", data: {icon: "inline-start"}) do |s|
      s.path(d: "M3.85 8.62a4 4 0 0 1 4.78-4.77 4 4 0 0 1 6.74 0 4 4 0 0 1 4.78 4.78 4 4 0 0 1 0 6.74 4 4 0 0 1-4.77 4.78 4 4 0 0 1-6.75 0 4 4 0 0 1-4.78-4.77 4 4 0 0 1 0-6.76Z")
      s.path(d: "m9 12 2 2 4-4")
    end
    plain "Verified"
  end
  Badge(variant: :outline) do
    plain "Bookmark"
    svg(xmlns: "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", width: "24", height: "24", viewbox: "0 0 24 24", fill: "none",
      stroke: "currentColor", stroke_width: "2", stroke_linecap: "round", stroke_linejoin: "round",
      aria_hidden: "true", data: {icon: "inline-end"}) do |s|
      s.path(d: "m19 21-7-4-7 4V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h10a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v16z")
    end
  end
end
```

### As Link

```ruby
Badge(href: "#") do
  plain "Open Link"
  svg(xmlns: "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", width: "24", height: "24", viewbox: "0 0 24 24", fill: "none",
    stroke: "currentColor", stroke_width: "2", stroke_linecap: "round", stroke_linejoin: "round",
    aria_hidden: "true", data: {icon: "inline-end"}) do |s|
    s.path(d: "M7 7h10v10")
    s.path(d: "M7 17 17 7")
  end
end
```

### Custom Colors

```ruby
div(class: "flex flex-wrap gap-2 justify-center") do
  Badge(class: "bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-950 dark:text-blue-300") { "Blue" }
  Badge(class: "bg-green-50 text-green-700 dark:bg-green-950 dark:text-green-300") { "Green" }
  Badge(class: "bg-sky-50 text-sky-700 dark:bg-sky-950 dark:text-sky-300") { "Sky" }
  Badge(class: "bg-purple-50 text-purple-700 dark:bg-purple-950 dark:text-purple-300") { "Purple" }
  Badge(class: "bg-red-50 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-950 dark:text-red-300") { "Red" }
end
```

### Sizes

```ruby
div(class: "flex flex-wrap gap-2 justify-center items-center") do
  Badge(size: :sm) { "Small" }
  Badge(size: :md) { "Medium" }
  Badge(size: :lg) { "Large" }
end
```
